                                              Corporate Profile

                                                                          綠城中國控股有限公司是中國領先的優質房產品開發及生活綜
                                                                          合服務供應商，以優秀的產品質量、獨特的建築美學、以人為
                                                                          本的服務保持行業引領地位。公司連續十九年榮獲「中國房地產
                                                                          百強企業綜合實力TOP10」1 ，所進駐重點城市客戶滿意度連續
                                                                          十二年保持領先，連續三年位列「中國房地產產品力優秀企業」
                                                                          榜單第一 1，多年榮獲「社會責任感企業」等殊榮。

                                                                          Greentown China Holdings Limited is a leading quality property
                                                                          developer and integrated living service provider in China. It
                                                                          maintains a leadership position in the industry by virtue of the
                                              象山桂語江南
                                                                          quality of its properties, its unique architectural aesthetics,
                                              Xiangshan Osmanthus Grace   and its customer-centric services. The Company has been
                                                                          awarded the “Top 10 among 100 Chinese Real Estate Enterprises
                                                                          by Comprehensive Strength” 1 for 19 consecutive years and
                                                                          maintained a leading position in customer satisfaction in core
                                                                          cities it operates in for 12 consecutive years as well as ranked first
                                                                          among “Chinese Real Estate Enterprises with Excellent Product
002                                                                       Strength”1 for three consecutive years. It has also received such
                                                                          honors as “Enterprise with Social Responsibility” for many years.

                                                                                                                         義烏桃花源
                                                                                                                         Yiwu Peach Garden




                                              2022年，疫情反覆、經濟形勢嚴峻，叠加房地產調控政策劇烈變化，中國房地產行業經歷前所未有之大
                                              變局。2023年前兩月，儘管「築底回暖」的蹟象愈加明顯，但「全面復蘇」尚需時日。居民購房信心恢復，
                                              需要經濟基本面好轉、收入增加、市場回暖等多重因素綜合影響。




Greentown China Holdings Limited 綠城中國控股有限公司
                                              In 2022, the real estate industry in the PRC has undergone unprecedented changes due to the prolonged
                                              pandemic, grim economic outlook and drastic changes in real estate regulatory policies. The first two months
                                              in 2023 saw clearer signs of “bottoming out”, but a “full recovery” still takes time. The recovery of residents’
                                              confidence in house purchasing requires a combination of factors such as improving economic fundamentals,
                                              increasing income and rebound of market.
主席報告
Chairman’s Statement




在市場恢復進程中，「四個分化」將更加明顯：一     In the process of market recovery, “four differentiations” will become more
是市場分化，高能級城市的行情，優於低能級城      intensified. First, market differentiation. Markets in high-tier cities are better than
市；高能級都市圈的風險抵抗力，強於低能級都      those in low-tier cities, thus the resilience to risks of high-tier municipalities is
市圈。二是企業分化，綜合能力越強的企業抗風      stronger than that of low-tier municipalities. Second, enterprise differentiation.
險能力越強、發展前景更好；能力較弱的企業將      Enterprises with stronger integrated capabilities will be more resilient to risks
越來越難以生存。這種分化不僅促使行業集中度      with better development prospects, and it will be increasingly difficult for those
提高，而且導致企業之間的差距正在拉大。三是      less capable to survive. Such differentiation not only catalyses the industry
產品分化，隨著市場回落，消費者越來越願意為      concentration level, but it also widens the disparity between enterprises.
好產品買單，產品力將是企業的核心競爭力。四      Third, product differentiation. As the market cools down, consumers are
是資源分化，房地產是資源密集型行業，尤其       more willing to pay for premium products, and product quality will become
是金融資源，正在越來越明顯地傾斜到那些有核      the core competitiveness of enterprises. Fourth, resource differentiation. The
心競爭力的企業手上。簡而言之，一二綫城市將      real estate industry is regarded as resource-intensive, particularly in terms of
較快恢復，三四綫城市則恢復緩慢，甚至無法恢      financial resources, which are increasingly slanted towards companies with
復；金融、土地等資源將向頭部房企集中。        core competencies. In other words, the market in first- and second-tier cities
                           will recover in a faster pace, while the third- and fourth-tier cities experience
                           slow recovery or they are unable to recover at all. Besides, financial and land
                           resources will be concentrated in the leading real estate enterprises.

            率、違約虧損率（即發生違約時的                  loss given default (i.e. the magnitude of the loss if there is a default)
            虧損程度）及違約風險。評估違約                  and the exposure at default. The assessment of the probability of
            概率及違約虧損率根據歷史數據，                  default and loss given default is based on historical data adjusted
            並按前瞻性資料進行調整。預期                   by forward-looking information. Estimation of ECL reflects an
            信貸虧損的估計反映無偏頗及概率                  unbiased and probability-weighted amount that is determined with
            加權金額，其以發生違約風險的金                  the respective risks of default occurring as the weights. The Group
            額作為加權數值而確定。在估計貿                  uses a practical expedient in estimating ECL on trade receivables
            易應收款項評估預期信貸虧損時，                  using a provision matrix taking into consideration historical credit
            本集團使用可行權宜方法，運用撥                  loss experience, adjusted by forward-looking information that is            199
            備矩陣估計貿易應收款項的預期信                  available without undue cost or effort.

            驗，並就毋須付出過多成本或努力
            即可獲取的前瞻性資料作出調整。


            一般而言，預期信貸虧損為根據合                  Generally, the ECL is the difference between all contractual cash
            同到期應付本集團的所有合同現金                  flows that are due to the Group in accordance with the contract
            流量與本集團預期收取的現金流量                  and the cash flows that the Group expects to receive, discounted

            的實際利率貼現。

                                                    本集團於2021年12月31日持有的商譽產生             The goodwill held by the Group as at 31 December 2021 arose on the
                                                    自於2015年收購附屬公司綠城房地產建設               acquisition of subsidiaries, namely Greentown Real Estate Construction
                                                    管理集團有限公司（「綠城建設管理集團」）               Management Group Co., Ltd. (“Greentown Construction Management
                                                    及綠城時代城市建設發展有限公司（「綠城                Group”) and Greentown Shidai Urban Construction Development Co.,
                                                    時代」），原因為就收購事項實際支付的代                Ltd. (“Greentown Shidai”) in 2015 because the consideration paid for the
                                                    價已計及預期協同效應利益、收入增長及                 acquisition effectively included the benefit of expected synergies, revenue
                                                    綠城建設管理集團及綠城時代的未來市場                 growth and future market development of Greentown Construction
256
                                                    發展。該等利益不會與商譽分開確認，原                 Management Group and Greentown Shidai. These benefits are not

                                              44.   退休福利計劃                         44.     Retirement Benefits Plans
                                                    本集團在中國內地的附屬公司僱員屬政府                     The employees of the Group’s subsidiaries in Mainland China are
                                                    管理的國家退休福利計劃成員。該等附屬                     members of the state-managed retirement benefits schemes operated
                                                    公司須將發薪的若干百分比向退休福利計                     by the government. These subsidiaries are required to contribute a
                                                    劃供款，以為該等福利提供資金。本集團                     certain percentage of payroll costs to the retirement benefits schemes
                                                    對退休福利計劃的唯一責任是作出所規定                     to fund the benefits. The only obligation of the Group with respect to the
                                                    供款。                                    retirement benefits schemes is to make the specified contributions.
